title: Brent hits $116 and Meta's AI bill rattles tech: Wall Street slips for a second week
short: Brent hits $116, Meta's AI bill rattles tech; S&P 500 slips again
dek: A chip-stock rout on Thursday and oil at a six-month high pulled the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower for a second straight week. Small companies and the Dow held up.
card: S&P 500 −0.5%, Nasdaq −0.7%, Dow +0.4% for the week. Brent settled at $116.72. What it means for India on Monday.
